prepare: rustup show active-toolchain && rustup which rust-analyzer

python3 -c 'import json,subprocess; actual={row["group"] for row in json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["python3","scripts/linux-test-partitions.py","linux-matrix"]))["include"]}; assert actual == {'"'"'core-contracts'"'"', '"'"'runtime'"'"', '"'"'root-lib-sessions'"'"', '"'"'root-journeys'"'"', '"'"'core-storage'"'"', '"'"'root-transport'"'"'}, "Linux groups changed; update the trusted Hauler recipe before delegation"'

tasks.run: status=0; python3 scripts/linux-test-partitions.py run-linux-group root-journeys || status=$?; if [ -f target/nextest/linux/timings.json ]; then cp target/nextest/linux/timings.json target/nextest/linux/timings-root-journeys.json || exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

status=0; python3 scripts/linux-test-partitions.py run-linux-group root-transport || status=$?; if [ -f target/nextest/linux/timings.json ]; then cp target/nextest/linux/timings.json target/nextest/linux/timings-root-transport.json || exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

status=0; python3 scripts/linux-test-partitions.py run-linux-group core-storage || status=$?; if [ -f target/nextest/linux/timings.json ]; then cp target/nextest/linux/timings.json target/nextest/linux/timings-core-storage.json || exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

status=0; python3 scripts/linux-test-partitions.py run-linux-group root-lib-sessions || status=$?; if [ -f target/nextest/linux/timings.json ]; then cp target/nextest/linux/timings.json target/nextest/linux/timings-root-lib-sessions.json || exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

status=0; python3 scripts/linux-test-partitions.py run-linux-group runtime || status=$?; if [ -f target/nextest/linux/timings.json ]; then cp target/nextest/linux/timings.json target/nextest/linux/timings-runtime.json || exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

status=0; python3 scripts/linux-test-partitions.py run-linux-group core-contracts || status=$?; if [ -f target/nextest/linux/timings.json ]; then cp target/nextest/linux/timings.json target/nextest/linux/timings-core-contracts.json || exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

set -eu; cd dashboard; pnpm run build; pnpm test; python3 ../scripts/check-dashboard-bundle.py app-dist; (cd app-dist && find . -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum) > /tmp/dashboard-dist.sha; pnpm run build; (cd app-dist && find . -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum) | diff /tmp/dashboard-dist.sha -

set -eu; export TRACEDECAY_SKIP_DASHBOARD_BUILD=1; TRACEDECAY_DASHBOARD_BUNDLE_SHA256="$(python3 scripts/check-dashboard-bundle.py dashboard/app-dist --print-digest)"; export TRACEDECAY_DASHBOARD_BUNDLE_SHA256; hauler exec -- cargo build --package tracedecay-cli --bin tracedecay --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-default-features --features production --locked; binary=target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/tracedecay; test -x "$binary"; "$binary" --version; "$binary" --help >/dev/null
